name: Reverse Almanac Order
description: Reverses the seed-chooser order, Gem/Ticket Shop costs, and where each plant is unlocked (world map + Epic Quest, 53 slots) in PvZ2 Gardendless (excluding Zen Garden Mint). World map patch is experimental (requires enabling worldmap-json) and only the 'egypt' world codename/level-ID pattern is confirmed against real docs -- back up your save.
